reorder.note: Two opaque squares over matching bases. At 0.5 the left base moves over its multiply ink; the screen pair keeps its order.

window.note: The clip is smaller than the left pair; both pairs are counted inside its box.

inverse.note: The inverse clip is far away from every drawn attachment, so it removes no artwork.

hidden.note: A positive control turns on the far-away attachment excluded from the default bounds.
